name: Zaratán (Spain)
description: Square red flag charged at the centre with the crowned arms of Zaratán (a Templar cross on blue above yellow bars on red).
history: The heraldic arms and the flag were officially approved on 4 February 1994 and published in the Boletín Oficial del Estado of 2 March 1994; the arms are azure with the great cross of the Temple in silver at the centre and three yellow bars on red in the lower part, and the flag is square, gules, with the municipal arms in their colours at the centre.
